claims.evidence: Paper: mouse N2a-Cl3 cells, searched against M. musculus UniProt; PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; NCBITaxon:10090 verified in OLS.

Paper Methods: "N2a-Cl3 cells previously infected with the Rocky Mountain Laboratories strain of prion aggregate (RML) were generously provided by the Prusiner laboratory"; Supp Table S2 legend "N2a Cl3". The subclone has no Cellosaurus/CLO/BTO/EFO entry (validator warning accepted; Neuro-2a EFO:0022756 would lose the subclone identity).

claims.location: characteristics[cellosaurus accession] / characteristics[cellosaurus name] all rows
claims.evidence: N2a-Cl3 is a Prusiner-lab subclone of N2a (= Neuro-2a, CVCL_0470, synonyms N2a/N2A); the subclone itself is not in Cellosaurus, so the parent line is cited. CVCL_6268 ScN2a (RML-infected Neuro-2a) was not used because it does not describe the quinacrine-cleared arm and is not stated to be the same subclone.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0470: "Derived from site: In situ; Peripheral nervous system; UBERON=UBERON_0000010"; OLS UBERON:0000010 peripheral nervous system.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0470: "Cell type: Neural crest derived neuroblast; CL=CL_0002676"; OLS CL:0002676.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0470 DI NCIt C21993 Mouse neuroblastoma; MONDO:0005072 neuroblastoma (OLS). The prion-infection state is in characteristics[infection status], not here.
Cultured N2a-Cl3 cells.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0470 "Breed/subspecies: A/J". Validator warning (free text, not in NCBITaxon) accepted.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0470 SX Male.
Paper: cells "were generously provided by the Prusiner laboratory".

Paper: cultures maintained in, and SILAC-labelled in, Eagle's Minimum Essential Medium (ATCC / Thermo MEM for SILAC) with 15% dialyzed FBS. NCIT has no MEM term (OLS search; only DMEM NCIT:C185409), so the stated name is written; validator warning accepted.

Each (infection status, labelling day) group is one culture harvested at that day (paper: cells collected after 0,1,2,3,5 days of labelling; one MaxQuant experiment per arm and day). Light and heavy rows of one run are the same culture. No replicate cultures are described or deposited, so n = 1 per factor-value group.

claims.value: N day = days in 13C6-Lys/Arg labelling medium
claims.evidence: Paper: cells switched to heavy medium and collected after 1, 2, 3, 5 days (whole proteome) and 1-4 days (PrPSc isolates); MaxQuant experiments "RML day 1..5"/"RML+QA day 1..5"; PK runs Hutti_PK+Day2/3/4. Heavy share rises with the day for every annotated run (timepoint_check.tsv). Day 0 (unlabelled) samples were not deposited.
Cellosaurus: "Age unspecified".

claims.value: SILAC light = pre-existing (unlabelled) proteome; SILAC heavy = protein newly synthesised during the 13C6-Arg/13C6-Lys label period
claims.evidence: Dynamic SILAC: "The rate by which unlabeled (light) proteins within the cell are replaced by newly synthesized labeled (heavy) proteins can be quantified". Each run carries both states of ONE culture; source names end _preexisting (light) / _newlysynthesized (heavy) as in campaign precedent PXD023790 (pulse SILAC). Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg6;Lys6 in the PK and NaBu summary.txt; the whole-proteome summary.txt is lost in the truncated zip, but msms.txt carries Labeling State 0/1 for every run.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term variable; Label:13C(6) R and K (UNIMOD:188) variable
claims.evidence: PK search parameters.txt: Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C); summary.txt Variable Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term), Labels1 Arg6;Lys6. Whole-proteome search: msms.txt Modifications vocabulary = Unmodified / Oxidation (M) / Acetyl (Protein N-term) only, msms.txt header columns "Acetyl (Protein N-term)", "Oxidation (M)"; Table S1 peptide masses show +57.021 Da per Cys on all 5216 Cys peptides (fixed carbamidomethyl); labels 13C6 Arg/13C6 Lys from paper and PRIDE protocol (Arg6/Lys6 = UNIMOD:188, rule 11). Paper Table S6 "Modifications included in protein quantification: Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term)".

Paper/PRIDE: S-trap digestion with trypsin; MaxQuant Enzyme Trypsin, Specific. (Proteinase K in the PrPSc arm is a pre-digestion isolation step on native lysate, not the peptide-generating enzyme; recorded in the source name and enrichment process.)
